title: Lightweight Ops Orchestrator: Admin Agent & Runbook-as-Task Framework
creator: Maya Patel
description: Build a lightweight Ops Orchestrator agent and framework that turns curated runbooks into idempotent tasks with rich telemetry hooks. Goals: (1) enable on-call engineers to execute verified admin workflows as composable tasks from the support UI or CLI, (2) attach distributed tracing and structured logs to each step for faster incident triage, (3) provide safe defaults (dry-run, canary, guarded escalation) to avoid accidental live changes, and (4) expose a plugin API for custom infra actions (k8s, db, infra-as-code triggers). Deliverables: agent binary + minimal JS/Go SDK, a runbook->task compiler (yaml to task graph), UI integration points (task run modal + audit trail), demo runbooks for disk-pressure, KV cache flush, and model fallback switchover.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Create agent that can run a three-step sample runbook with retries and idempotency checks. 2) UI shows per-step traces and logs for a task run in under 3s after completion. 3) Dry-run and gated approval steps are supported. 4) Plugin interface documented and two example plugins (k8s rollout, s3 lifecycle) included. 5) End-to-end test and a canary rollout plan documented.
